method: Manual visual inspection of all three 0.5 s minimum-spacing contact sheets and selected original-resolution frames. FFmpeg applies the source display rotation; PIL rotations/crops were used only as diagnostic views. Boundaries are approximate, bracketed by sampled times, and are not exact page-turn ground truth.

capture_conditions.note: Source encoded 3840x2160 with display rotation -90 degrees, rendered by FFmpeg as 2160x3840. Invoice, QR supplement, registry and quality pages additionally need content rotation +90 degrees clockwise; the final white continuation needs -90 degrees.

Paper movement and blur occur around sampled page turns, particularly about 3.2-3.7, 7.0-7.5, 10.1-10.7, 12.8-13.3, 16.0-16.5, 18.1-18.7, 20.8-21.3, 22.9-23.5, 29.3-29.9, 32.0-32.5 and 34.7-35.2 s. More stable holds appear between turns.

A folded prior sheet covers portions of the upper-left corners for much of the recording; fingers sometimes cover lower/marginal content. Curvature and perspective change especially during turns and on the final continuation. Several sheets show other documents beneath them.

Selected original-resolution headings and page footers are visually legible after rotation. Dense small tables, decorative backgrounds, stamps and overprints remain separate field-extraction challenges. No OCR field accuracy, calibrated quality score or automated classification accuracy was measured.

validation_limits: Manual observations of this one supplied clip only.
No remote services used; QR content not followed.
No document-field extraction accuracy or target-class acceptance measured.
The final invoice continuation linkage is an inference from layout because its title is absent.
selected_frame_note: Two original frames represent quality certificate page 3 (24.52 and 28.25 s); 13 selected originals do not mean 13 distinct pages.
